title: PatternValueNullBounds
$comment: Issue #270's third shape at the position it is shared with: every scalar bound in the pattern-value bucket decodes the raw value into a Go type and reads what it finds, and encoding/json takes a JSON null into any type as a no-op with no error -- so a null was measured as 0, as "" and as an empty array. Each family gets a key of its own so a fix to one is not read as a fix to all four.
